# @trysac/mcp-sqlite-readonly

> Read-only MCP server over a SQLite file loaded into memory with sql.js: query_only pragma, single SELECT statements, bound parameters, row, cell and size caps TypeScript library for Node.js 20+, published as ES modules with type declarations. MIT.
